title: Chat2DB – AI-Powered Database Client for SQL Queries
description:
Chat2DB is a free, open-source database client with built-in AI. Ask questions in plain English and get SQL answers. Works with MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, and more. Download for Windows, Mac, or Linux.
